html:
.item {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-width: 0;
  min-height: var(--item-height);
  position: relative;
  border-radius: 4px;
  background: transparent;
  transition: background var(--motion-hover) ease-out;
}
.item[data-interactive="true"]:not([data-disabled="true"]):hover {
  background: var(--surface-hover);
}
.item[data-interactive="true"]:not([data-disabled="true"]):active {
  background: var(--surface-pressed);
}
.item[data-selected="true"] {
  background: var(--selection);
}
.item[data-selected="true"]::before {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 8px auto 8px 0;
  width: 2px;
  background: var(--primary);
  content: "";
}
.item[data-selected="true"]:not([data-disabled="true"]):hover {
  background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary) 12%, var(--surface));
}
.item:has(:focus-visible) {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: -2px;
}
.main {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex: 1;
  align-self: stretch;
  min-width: 0;
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border: 0;
  border-radius: inherit;
  background: transparent;
  color: inherit;
  text-align: left;
  outline: none;
}
button.main {
  cursor: pointer;
}
.main:disabled {
  cursor: default;
  opacity: 0.45;
}
.leading {
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  width: 20px;
  height: 20px;
}
.leading svg {
  width: 16px;
  height: 16px;
  stroke-width: 1.75;
}
.content {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 0;
}
.title {
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 20px;
  font-weight: 500;
}
.description {
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 16px;
  color: var(--text-secondary);
  overflow: hidden;
  text-overflow: ellipsis;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.trailing {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-shrink: 0;
  padding-right: 12px;
}
.item[data-density="compact"]:not([data-double="true"]) {
  min-height: var(--item-height-compact);
}
.item[data-density="compact"]:not([data-double="true"]) .main {
  padding: 4px 8px;
}
.item[data-density="compact"]:not([data-double="true"]) .title {
  font-size: 13px;
}
.item[data-density="compact"] .trailing {
  padding-right: 8px;
}
.item[data-double="true"] {
  min-height: var(--item-height-double);
}
.item[data-double="true"] .leading {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}
.item[data-loading="true"] .title,
.item[data-loading="true"] .description {
  color: transparent;
  background: var(--surface-raised);
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.error {
  color: var(--destructive);
  font-size: 12px;
  line-height: 20px;
}
.error summary {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  min-height: 28px;
  cursor: pointer;
  border-radius: 4px;
}
.error summary:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}
.error p {
  max-width: 240px;
  overflow-wrap: anywhere;
  padding: 8px;
}
.item:has(.error[open]) {
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}
.trailing:has(.error[open]) {
  flex-basis: 100%;
  flex-shrink: 1;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  padding-left: 12px;
}
@media (pointer: coarse) {
  .error summary {
    min-height: 44px;
  }
  .item[data-interactive="true"] {
    min-height: max(var(--touch-target), var(--item-height));
  }
  .item[data-interactive="true"] .main {
    min-height: var(--touch-target);
  }
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .item {
    transition: none;
  }
}
